source: Audio_Study_abroad.m4a (8 kHz phone recording, 160.5 s), transcribed with Whisper large-v3-turbo and checked by hand

utterances.text: Hello Sumit ji, main Aarushi bol rahi hoon Highvance Overseas se. | Aapne abhi *Germany* mein study ke liye enquiry ki hai,
usi ke regarding aapse baat karni thi.
Do minute baat kar sakte hain?
Haan ji, batao, kya baat karni hai?

Haan, bilkul. | Aapke Master's in Mechanical Engineering ke liye | Germany mein kai universities ke Autumn intake hote hain, | aam taur par September mein. | Kya aap abhi apna graduation year | aur current graduation percentage bata sakte hain?
Theek hai, hamara *2026* hai.
Samajh gayi, aapka graduation year 2026 hai. | Ab aapka graduation percentage kya hai?
94 pratishat, bahut achha! | Ab aapne English proficiency test diya hai? | Jaise IELTS ya TOEFL?
*IELTS* diya hai.
IELTS koi problem nahi.
Kai German universities minimum 6 band overall accept karti hain, | lekin exact requirement university-wise varies.
Kya aap senior counsellor Priya ke saath | ek *free* *video* *call* book karna chahenge?
Pehle mujhe batao, | mera admission kaun-kaun se colleges mein ho sakta hai?

Main bata sakti hoon ki Germany mein Mechanical Engineering ke liye | kai top universities jaise Technical University of Munich, | RWTH Aachen aur Karlsruhe Institute of Technology | mein strong programs hain. | Unki exact eligibility aur shortlist ke liye | Priya aapki profile ko detail mein dekhegi. | Kya aap abhi ek free video call book karna chahenge?
Process kya hota hai admission ka?

Process mein sabse pehle aap universities ki shortlist banate hain, | phir unke specific requirements ke anusaar | documents taiyaar karte hain, | jaise transcripts, English test score aur SOP. | Uske baad online application submit karte hain, | university review karti hai, | aur phir admission decision aata hai. | Kya aap abhi Priya ke saath free video call book karna chahenge?
Video call pe kya hoga?

Video call mein Priya aapki poori profile dekhegi, | aapka academic background, English score | aur financial planning samjhegi, | aur aapko universities ki shortlist, intake options | aur scholarship possibilities ke baare mein | personalised guidance degi. | Ye session poori tarah *free* hai | aur aapke agle steps clear kar dega. | Kya aap abhi ek slot book karna chahenge?
Waise fees kitni lagegi mujhe, | on average, Germany mein padhne ke liye?
Germany mein public universities ki tuition | bahut kam ya nahi hoti, | aur living cost lagbhag *8* *lakh* se *10* *lakh* rupees saalana hoti hai. | Kya is baare mein aur kuch poochhna chahenge?
Achha, nahi nahi, theek hai.
Theek hai. | Agar aage koi sawaal ya madad chahiye toh bataiye. | Shukriya.
